groups.title: Understand a service
groups.description: Start from its boundaries and follow the evidence.

intents.title: Inspect a service and its connections
intents.goal: Inspect the service's entry points, tables, topics and downstream calls.

intents.title: Find code and follow a data flow
intents.goal: Locate exact source evidence and follow entry points to their effects.

intents.title: Map decisions and data changes
intents.goal: Follow an exact entry through control decisions, transformations, callee bodies and exits; inspect assumptions before fixing the bug.

intents.title: Review or correct a detected boundary
intents.goal: Inspect detected evidence before making a documented manual correction.

groups.title: Explore data
groups.description: Resolve exact names before a live query.

intents.title: Find a table, topic or API
intents.goal: Find the exact cached object name and preserve its source generation.

intents.title: Inspect a table and who uses it
intents.goal: Inspect the selected table or function and its detected readers and writers.

intents.title: Query rows, documents or messages
intents.goal: Read a bounded sample from an explicitly selected source.

groups.title: Investigate a bug
groups.description: Connect the symptom to deployment, code and state.

intents.title: Investigate an unexplained symptom
intents.goal: Collect deployment, health and log evidence before diagnosing the symptom.

intents.title: Recreate related state and replay a bug
intents.goal: Prepare a bounded reproduction with independent expectations and explicit gaps.

groups.title: Change and verify code
groups.description: Use exact source revisions and explicit execution targets.

intents.title: Prepare an integration regression
intents.goal: Drive an application entry point and independently check its exit effects.

intents.title: Compare behavior across a refactor
intents.goal: Compare baseline and candidate behavior using representative inputs.

groups.title: APIs and reusable checks
groups.description: Inspect a request before sending it.

intents.title: Explore or replay an API request
intents.goal: Prepare an attributed API request and inspect its actual response.

intents.title: Run or build a reusable workflow
intents.goal: Compose a repeatable investigation with editable parameters and explicit assertions.

groups.title: Knowledge and task memory
groups.description: Resume prior findings or prepare shared understanding.

intents.title: Explain architecture and data flows
intents.goal: Inspect source-linked project understanding and keep assumptions explicit.

intents.title: Resume a task or work with files
intents.goal: Find prior work, consult its progress and preserve useful evidence.
